before_action.text: 正中线和胸骨切开范围再核对一次，进入后需要足够的心包暴露。
before_action.text_en: Recheck the midline and sternotomy extent. We'll need adequate pericardial exposure after entry.

before_action.text: 胸骨锯、骨蜡和开胸牵开器按顺序准备。
before_action.text_en: Sternal saw, bone wax, and sternotomy retractor are ready in sequence.

after_resolution.text: 胸骨进入已经完成，我先保护胸骨边缘并协助展开术野。
after_resolution.text_en: Sternal entry is complete. I'll protect the sternal edges and help open the field.

before_action.text: 准备配合抗凝与体外循环建立，循环转接的关键时间点请逐项通报。
before_action.text_en: We're preparing anticoagulation and bypass. Please call out each critical step in the transition.

before_action.text: 插管器械、荷包缝线和右房牵开器都已经备齐。
before_action.text_en: Cannulation instruments, purse-string sutures, and right atrial retractors are ready.

after_resolution.text: 右心房暴露后先找解剖瓣环，不能拿下移的瓣叶附着处当作真正边界。
after_resolution.text_en: With the right atrium exposed, identify the true annulus; the displaced leaflet attachment is not that boundary.

after_resolution.text: 体外循环相关耗材与时间记录已接手，备用管路保持待命。
after_resolution.text_en: Bypass supply and timing records are being maintained. Backup tubing remains available.

before_action.text: 前叶活动范围很大，但异常附着点要逐段游离，保留可用的瓣叶组织。
before_action.text_en: The anterior leaflet has substantial motion, but abnormal attachments must be released in stages to preserve useful tissue.

before_action.text: 心脏精细剪、无创镊和细小牵引缝线。
before_action.text_en: Fine cardiac scissors, atraumatic forceps, and delicate traction sutures.

after_resolution.text: 我把右室壁轻轻撑开，注意别把薄的心肌当成瓣叶继续拉。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll gently support the right ventricular wall. Don't mistake thin myocardium for leaflet tissue.

after_resolution.text: 瓣叶游离时仍在循环支持阶段，我持续复核灌注与温度趋势。
after_resolution.text_en: We're still on circulatory support during leaflet mobilization. I'll keep reviewing perfusion and temperature trends.

before_action.text: 后叶和隔叶靠近传导区域，先确认能安全松开的边界。
before_action.text_en: The posterior and septal leaflets lie near conduction tissue. Identify the safely releasable boundaries.

before_action.text: 更细的剪和小钩式牵引器，准备局部操作。
before_action.text_en: Finer scissors and a small hook retractor are ready for this localized work.

after_resolution.text: 瓣叶释放范围已经重新核对，关键的前隔交界要保留辨认标志。
after_resolution.text_en: The leaflet-release extent is rechecked. Preserve the landmarks around the anteroseptal commissure.

after_resolution.text: 细缝线和小棉片已经补到台面，换下一组器械不需停太久。
after_resolution.text_en: Fine sutures and small pledgets are replenished. The next instrument change should be brief.

before_action.text: 现在看可用瓣叶能否围成连续的锥形，面积不够的部位必须提前标出来。
before_action.text_en: Assess whether the usable leaflets can form a continuous cone. Mark any tissue deficit before reconstruction.

before_action.text: 隔叶一侧的活动度较有限，我会维持位置供你判断重建路径。
before_action.text_en: Mobility is more limited on the septal side. I'll hold the position while you select the repair path.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的瓣叶组合方向进行，所有针脚都要避开预计的传导组织区域。
after_resolution.text_en: Proceed with the selected leaflet configuration. Keep every suture away from the expected conduction region.

after_resolution.text: 瓣叶成形用细线已分组放好，需要更换长度随时说。
after_resolution.text_en: Fine sutures for leaflet construction are grouped and ready. Call for another length if needed.

before_action.text: 把游离后的瓣叶边缘顺着计划方向汇合，先保证一整圈连续性。
before_action.text_en: Bring the freed leaflet edges together along the planned path, establishing circumferential continuity first.

before_action.text: 小持针器、细瓣膜缝线和无创镊。
before_action.text_en: Small needle holder, fine valve sutures, and atraumatic forceps.

before_action.text: 腱索的空间我来撑开，旋转瓣叶时别把它们卷进缝合线。
before_action.text_en: I'll hold the chordal space open so the rotating leaflets don't entangle them in the suture line.

after_resolution.text: 我从内侧撑开新形成的 Cone，检查缝合线有没有卷到腱索。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll open the newly formed cone from inside and check that no chordae are caught in the suture line.

after_resolution.text: 瓣膜成形所用针线正在逐项登记，备用精细线已留出。
after_resolution.text_en: Valve-repair needles and sutures are being logged individually. Backup fine sutures are reserved.

before_action.text: 折叠心房化右室之前，先确认右冠状动脉所在的房室沟位置。
before_action.text_en: Before plicating the atrialized right ventricle, confirm the right coronary artery's course in the atrioventricular groove.

before_action.text: 心肌折叠缝线和带小垫片的备用针组。
before_action.text_en: Myocardial plication sutures and a backup pledgeted needle set.

after_resolution.text: 折叠线的走向已经看清，瓣环调整不能让右室余下的腔室受挤压。
after_resolution.text_en: The plication line is visible. Annular adjustment must not compress the remaining right ventricular cavity.

after_resolution.text: 心室几何关系正在调整，后面功能评估时会重点核对右室表现。
after_resolution.text_en: Ventricular geometry is changing. We'll focus on right ventricular performance during functional assessment.

before_action.text: 真正的瓣环就在这里，隔侧传导组织区域我会持续指出。
before_action.text_en: Here's the true annulus. I'll keep identifying the conduction-sensitive septal region.

before_action.text: 瓣环再附着缝线、小持针器，针距标记也准备好了。
before_action.text_en: Annular reattachment sutures and the small needle holder are ready, along with spacing markers.

before_action.text: 先按真正瓣环的弧度分配针脚，不能照下移的附着线原样缝回去。
before_action.text_en: Space the sutures along the true annular arc; don't simply sew back to the displaced attachment line.

after_resolution.text: Cone 已围绕解剖瓣环就位，接下来要看它开合而不是只看缝线漂亮。
after_resolution.text_en: The cone is seated on the true annulus. Next, judge leaflet motion, not merely how neat the sutures look.

after_resolution.text: 试水和精细补针用器械已单独放好。
after_resolution.text_en: Leak-test and fine revision instruments are set aside separately.

before_action.text: 先用注水检查对合线，找出需要修正的短段，不要整体重新拉紧。
before_action.text_en: Test coaptation with saline. Identify short segments needing revision rather than tightening everything.

before_action.text: 注水器、细持针器和修补缝线。
before_action.text_en: Saline syringe, fine needle holder, and revision sutures.

after_resolution.text: 局部修正完成后再观察瓣叶接触，不能在右房关闭后才发现边缘问题。
after_resolution.text_en: Reassess leaflet contact after the local corrections. Don't discover an edge problem after closing the atrium.

after_resolution.text: 解剖复核完成，血流动力学的最终判断仍要等脱离体外循环。
after_resolution.text_en: The anatomical review is complete. Final hemodynamic judgment awaits separation from bypass.

before_action.text: 右心房关闭前，确认没有遗留的针线和游离组织挡住修复瓣膜。
before_action.text_en: Before right atrial closure, ensure no loose suture or tissue obstructs the repaired valve.

before_action.text: 右房关闭缝线和标准心脏持针器。
before_action.text_en: Right atrial closure sutures and the standard cardiac needle holder.

after_resolution.text: 右房缝合线已完成，我再检查一遍外侧是否被牵得过紧。
after_resolution.text_en: The right atrial suture line is complete. I'll check externally for excessive tension.

after_resolution.text: 术中补用的细针线已追加入记录，复温用品保持可用。
after_resolution.text_en: Additional fine needles and sutures are logged. Warming supplies remain available.

before_action.text: 准备逐步评估脱离体外循环的条件，超声与循环趋势一起判断。
before_action.text_en: We're preparing to assess readiness to separate from bypass, using echo and hemodynamic trends together.

before_action.text: 除了三尖瓣返流，还要看右室充盈和流出，不能只盯一项指标。
before_action.text_en: Look beyond tricuspid regurgitation to right ventricular filling and outflow; no single measure is enough.

after_resolution.text: 按照本阶段选择的评估和调整方案完成复核，再进入胸腔止血。
after_resolution.text_en: Complete the review according to this stage's assessment and adjustment plan before chest hemostasis.

after_resolution.text: 体外循环阶段的关键数据会完整交接，继续监测功能变化。
after_resolution.text_en: Key bypass data will be handed over in full. We'll continue monitoring functional changes.

before_action.text: 心包周围、插管部位和胸骨后方都要扫一遍，有些渗血会藏在牵开器下。
before_action.text_en: Survey the pericardium, cannulation sites, and retrosternal space. Oozing can hide beneath retractors.

before_action.text: 开始终末清点，纱布、针与器械分开回读。
before_action.text_en: Starting final counts, with sponges, needles, and instruments read back separately.

after_resolution.text: 无菌台物品核对完成，胸骨关闭器械可以接上。
after_resolution.text_en: The sterile-table items are accounted for. We can switch to sternal closure instruments.

before_action.text: 胸骨两侧对位先看清，钢丝不能压到深部管路。
before_action.text_en: Verify alignment of the sternal halves. Wires must not compress deeper tubing.

before_action.text: 胸骨钢丝、持针器和皮肤关闭器械。
before_action.text_en: Sternal wires, needle holders, and skin closure instruments.

after_resolution.text: 胸骨与软组织关闭已完成，转运前再检查引流管固定。
after_resolution.text_en: Sternal and soft-tissue closure is complete. Recheck drain fixation before transfer.

after_resolution.text: 终末清点及植入耗材记录完成，交接单移交复苏团队。
after_resolution.text_en: Final counts and implant-supply records are complete. The handoff goes to the recovery team.
